Reactive store for an AlphaProject

Source: R/class_project_store.R
AlphaProjectStore.Rd

Owns project datasets, analysis specifications, and results while exposing the embedded graph through the existing AlphaGraphStore. A project snapshot always embeds the current graph-store snapshot.

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Snapshots embed the current graph-store snapshot. Dataset and analysis updates invalidate affected results; graph edits are detected by input hashes. $result() returns only results for current inputs. Use reactive accessors in a reactive context or inside shiny::isolate(). Transactions commit project data; graph changes use the shared graphStore.

Public fields

graphStore

AlphaGraphStore holding the current project graph; initialized from the supplied project and shared with graph views.

AlphaProjectStore$transact()

Apply mutate to a private candidate and commit after optional validation. Failures preserve the previous state and are rethrown. Return invisible TRUE on commit or FALSE for a nested transaction.

Usage

AlphaProjectStore$transact(source, mutate, validate = FALSE)

Arguments

source

Character scalar identifying the origin of a committed change.

mutate

Function that modifies a private candidate object before it is committed.

validate

Logical; whether to validate the imported, returned, or modified object.

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Examples

store <- createAlphaProjectStore()
store$snapshot()$pValues("primary")
#> H1_NI  H1_S H2_NI  H2_S 
#> 0.012 0.001 0.030 0.162 
shiny::isolate(store$revision())
#> [1] 0
